notes: The existing and queued lists already cover all of Hubay's major violin output: the four concertos, Suite Op. 5, all 14 Scènes de la csárda, the Poèmes hongrois, the étude sets and nearly every numbered character-piece opus. I could not name any further violin work, or established arrangement of his music, with enough certainty about title, opus number and edition, so I have added nothing rather than risk inventing entries. Two gaps may be worth checking against IMSLP: possible remaining numbers of Op. 86 and Op. 87, and individual numbers of Op. 27.
